descriptions.w3d_d27k_button_overlays_8025fd78: Formats the highlight, grey and colour-specific names (colour 1 and 3 Blue, 2 Green, 4 Purple, 5 Red, otherwise a plain name) from the settings string at +124, loads each through 0x802b1510 and adds it to the scene at +112, sizing it from the settings at +20, scaled by +116 for the highlight; a failed load formats the error string. Finally calls 0x8026026c.
